heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy north; mostly to partly sunny south. Chance of a shower or sprinkle near the international border, slight chance south to around Route 2, mainly late in the day. Highs from the upper 50s to mid 60s, some mid 50s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Tonight
text: Chance of showers from Route 2 northward, becoming likely after midnight, with a chance south to around Route 4. Lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming light in sheltered valleys east of the Green Mountains, and gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly to mostly cloudy with scattered showers; chance of a thunderstorm from the northern Greens eastward. Highs in the low to mid 60s, with some upper 60s possible in southeastern valleys. Southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, and becoming west.
